sections.title: Section 3: The Role Of Sleep In Humans And Animals
sections.html:
biological

(adjective). thuộc sinh vật học

Biological sciences is the study of living animals and plants

survive

(verb). sống sót

Nobody can survive long without water.

fatal

(adjective). làm chết người

The disease is fatal.

predator

(noun). thú săn mồi sống

Many animals are natural predators.

attack

(noun). sự tấn công

Animals have to fight in the attacks to survive

reptile

(noun). bò sát

These are some common types of reptiles

mammal

(noun). động vật có vú, loài thú

Cows, humans and whales are all mammals.

encounter

(verb). gặp; đụng độ với

We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.

marine

(adjective). thuộc biển

Marine life includes animals and other organisms that live in the sea

balance

(verb). cân bằng, cân đối

Try to keep a balance between work and relaxation.

float

(verb). nổi

The dolphin must float to the surface as it sleeps

breathe

(verb). thở

He breathed deeply before speaking again.

consciousness

(noun). sự ý thức được

I can't remember any more—I must have lost consciousness.

on edge

(adverb). bối rối; hốt hoảng

she was a bit on edge till she heard he was safe

nap

(noun). giấc ngủ chợp (thường là vào ban ngày)

I had a short nap after lunch.

migrate

(verb). di trú (người, chim)

Birds migrate south in winter.

defense

(noun). sự phòng thủ

Soldiers died in defense of their country

lie down

(verb). sự ngả lưng chốc lát

I’m going to have a lie-down before dinner.

muscle

(noun). cơ

He poses his muscles in the mirror.

bone

(noun). xương

This fish has a lot of bones.

delicate

(adjective). mảnh dẻ, dễ tổn thương

The eye is one of the most delicate organs of the body.

injure

(verb). làm tổn thương; làm hại

He injured his knee while playing hockey.

determine

(verb). xác định

The vaccine is tested in order to determine its influence on people's health

associate

(verb). liên đới

Most people associate this brand with good quality.

sleep disorder

(noun). rối loạn giấc ngủ

Unfortunately, he has sleep disorder

organise

(verb). tổ chức, thiết lập

file

(verb). sắp đặt

These documents are filed so that they can be found easily

bizarre

(adjective). lạ lùng

She has a bizarre hairstyle

integrate

(verb). hòa nhập, hội nhập, tích hợp

I feel happy that I can integrate my work into others'

observe

(verb). quan sát

He is observing the stars

susceptibility

(noun). tính nhạy cảm, tính dễ tự ái

genetic

(adjective). thuộc về gen

Down syndrome is a genetic disorder.

contribution

(noun). sự đóng góp

Park Hang Seo's contribution to our national team is significant
